title: Job Request (v1)
description: The architect↔worker seam, worker-facing half. A strict subset / projection of work-order.v1: exactly the job fields the Engineer needs to do the work, plus the schema_version stamp. One version family with WorkOrder v1 — a v1 Work Order projects to a v1 Job Request with no worker churn. The Engineer identity (Ruflo, Claude, stub) is irrelevant: any process that accepts this schema and returns a valid Invoice can serve as the Engineer.

schema_version.description: Version of the Job Request contract. Additive changes bump the minor (consumers ignore unknown fields); breaking changes bump this major and open a compat window.

job_id.description: Unique identifier for this job (e.g. issue-101-20260613T120000Z).

title.description: Issue title — the Engineer's one-line task description.

body.description: Issue body — full requirements and acceptance criteria.

route.description: Model tier the Architect selected for this job based on scope.

scope.description: Architect's estimated complexity. Engineer reports scope_actual in the Invoice.

confidence.description: Classifier confidence that this issue is implementable autonomously.
